ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a stream food web diagram, containing algae, plankton, aquatic insect larvae, snails, mussels, crayfish, multiple kinds of fish, etc. In the lower left there is a fish labeled “Smallmouth Bass”. In the figure, multiple arrows point from the direction of other organisms or fish toward this Smallmouth Bass; the explanatory text at the bottom also describes Smallmouth as the dominant top-level fish predator. Reasoning: The question asks which animal is a tertiary consumer and is located at the top of the food web. Top consumers in a food web usually receive energy from other consumers, and are not shown as prey of other animals. The one in the figure that matches this position and description is Smallmouth Bass.
